usage.outputShape: body.predicted_trends[] ({trend, description}), body.content_ideas[] ({idea, type}), body.timing (string), body.processedAt (ISO)
quirks: Requires BOTH 'topic' and 'platform' string fields; 'platform' is mandatory but not documented in any schema — omitting it returns 400 with {status:'ERROR', error:{message:'Validation failed', details:[{field:'platform'}]}}.
Success response wraps result at top level (predicted_trends/content_ideas/timing); errors come back as {status:'ERROR', error:{...}}.
usage.guide: POST to https://gg402.vercel.app/social_media_trend_predictor with a JSON body containing both a 'topic' (keyword to analyze) and a 'platform' (e.g. 'twitter'). Payment is x402 USDC on Base ($0.01). The response is plain synchronous JSON: read body.predicted_trends[] for forecasted trends ({trend, description}), body.content_ideas[] for suggested posts ({idea, type}), and body.timing for the recommended posting window. If you omit 'platform' you get a 400 validation error even though it is not in the schema.
